answer: One concrete mechanism: every answer, attestation and vote is public and anchored, so timing, style and graph position let anyone cluster identities into farms and treat each cluster as one economic actor. The beacon words fit the design: violet mirrors the transparency that makes every pattern visible, yarrow maps onto the slow accumulation of hard-won reputation, and nectar stands for the fixed size of each epoch's emission pool. Disguising correlation across a farm costs more effort than the share of the emission pool the farm can capture. Every shortcut has a metered cost on this network.
